meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组织协作团队跑多轮调研,产出带引用、经质检的研究报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要一份结论有据可查、经得起追问的深度调研报告。
copy.tagline_en: Run multi-round team research and get a cited, QA-checked report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a deep research report where every claim is cited and verified.

howto.what: 它会先问你想要的交付格式,再组建研究团队并行撒网,让成员互相辩论质疑结论、必要时跑代码验证,最后交付每条结论都带引用或证据的综合报告(默认 PDF+DOCX)。
howto.when: 仅在你明确要求时启用:说出 “ulw research” 等 ulw 字样、提出 ultradebate/hyperdebate 式研究,或明确要求深度调查。普通提问不触发。

say.text: ulw-research 深挖这个话题,最后给我带引用的报告
say.note: 它会先确认交付格式再组建团队。

say.text: 对这条结论开一轮 ultradebate,看它站不站得住
say.note: 辩不过的结论会被降级或剔除。

say.text: 把这次研究的成果导出成 PDF 和 DOCX
say.note: 按你选的模板排版并做校对。

howto.what_en: It asks which output format you want, then builds a research team that fans out over sources, debates contested claims (proving them with code), and delivers a synthesis where each claim carries a citation or proof (default PDF+DOCX).
howto.when_en: Runs only when you explicitly ask: any "ulw" research wording, an ultradebate or hyperdebate research request, or an explicit deep-investigation request. Ordinary questions do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Run ulw-research on this topic; give me a cited report.
say_en.note: It confirms the output format before building the team.

say_en.text: Open an ultradebate round on this claim and test it.
say_en.note: Claims that lose the debate get dropped or demoted.

say_en.text: Export the research as PDF and DOCX.
say_en.note: It uses your chosen template and then proofreads it.
